snippet.title: DreeM Ascension - Final Game Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the final trailer for our indie game, DreeM Ascension! Enjoy :)

DreeM Ascension is a short story-driven horror boomer shooter adventure made by chazgoat & Flare in the span of a year and few months. You play as a Sightseer exploring a digital world you are trapped in. As you explore, you search for clues on escaping, eliminate bad guys, and discover the truth about the world you're in. There's so much to do, from exploring, chatting with NPCs, discovering lore, picking out a favorite loadout, or playing one of three arcade games! If this interests you, click the link below!

Wishlist now on Steam - Demo out on Halloween: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4333680/DreeM_Ascension/
